name: Krusk
summary: At Tarren Mill, Krusk seeks his captured scouts and the Syndicate's relics. Warchief Thrall sent him to investigate Durnholde Keep, but an ambush scattered his team.

sections.title: A Mission Gone Wrong
sections.body:
Krusk leads the effort from Tarren Mill after a failed strike at Durnholde Keep. Warchief Thrall sent him and a small team to scout Syndicate activity and recover relics tied to the fortress's grim past. The human outlaws were better entrenched and more coordinated than expected. An ambush inside the crumbling walls overwhelmed the orcish scouts.

Krusk fought his way out. Drull and Tog'thar were captured and locked within the ruins. Gol'dir, the expedition's leader, was taken to another Syndicate hold. Now Krusk directs Horde forces to breach Durnholde, recover the lost items, and free his comrades.

sections.title: Eyes on the Syndicate
sections.body: From Tarren Mill, Krusk tracks Syndicate movements in Hillsbrad. The fallen nobles of Alterac operate from Durnholde Keep, plotting against Horde outposts and their former Alliance brethren. Krusk watches leaders such as Lord Aliden Perenolde. He hopes to break their command before they threaten the Horde's tenuous foothold in Lordaeron.

faq.answer: At Tarren Mill, Krusk serves Warchief Thrall as an orc scout. He was sent to investigate Syndicate operations around Durnholde Keep and recover historic relics.

The Syndicate ambushed Krusk and his team inside Durnholde Keep. Krusk escaped. Drull and Tog'thar were imprisoned in the ruins, while Gol'dir, the expedition's leader, was taken to another Syndicate hold.

faq.q: Why is the Horde interested in Durnholde Keep?
faq.answer: The Horde seeks Durnholde Keep because it holds personal and historical meaning for Warchief Thrall. Aedelas Blackmoore raised Thrall there as a captive gladiator, before Thrall led the orcish rebellion that razed the keep.
You can find Krusk outdoors at Tarren Mill, the Horde settlement in northern Hillsbrad Foothills.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you see Krusk carry Warchief Thrall's interests into Lordaeron. He works to secure Durnholde's history and free captured orcs from Syndicate hands.
As an orc, helping Krusk rescue his fellow scouts touches the honor and painful history of the internment camps. Durnholde is where Thrall broke his people's chains.
